sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Weapon Maintenance is a Practical skill in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Enhancements
sections.text: After reaching level 3 in this skill, you have a chance to add a weapon enhancement when repairing a weapon. The enhancement only stays on the weapon until it loses 5% of the default max durability or until it gets repaired once again. It is possible to get two or more enhancements in a row when repairing the same gun in succession. Items with enhancements get an orange icon background.

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
- Reduces gun wear while shooting (0.5% per level → -25% at Elite Level)
- Reduces probability of wear during repair (1% per level → -50% at Elite Level)
- Elite level: Reduces wear chance when using repair kits (-50%)

sections.heading: How to raise
sections.text:
- Repairing weapons in the stash with the Weapon repair kit (Every ~5 points of weapon durability give 0.4 skill points)
- Completing the quest Safety Guarantee
- Completing the quest Consolation Prize
- Completing the quest Profitable Venture
- Completing the quest Goals and Means
- Completing the quest Calibration
